plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full hood, the pole, hook and noose, limbs and boots within frame. idle_h3_v1.action: A watchful trapper's idle that loops. He breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, he hitches the rope coil higher on his hip and tilts the pole so the noose sways under the hook, the hooded head turns slightly, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with sturdy steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The rope coil is carried at the hip and the hooked pole is held angled forward with the noose swinging; the skirt panels swing with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE hooking thrust toward screen right. He draws the pole back as the knees bend, then lunges forward and thrusts the hooked pole out to full reach at screen right with the noose swinging back, snaps the wrist to catch with the hook, pulls the pole back, straightens and settles into the original stance. One strike only; the rope coil stays in the other hand.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. He hunches over as the shoulders jerk and the knees flex, keeping hold of the coil and the pole, then straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Lift the thick rope coil high over the chest like a shield and bring the pole shaft diagonally across the front, then duck the head behind the raised coil in a deep low brace and hold the guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying call. He raises the rope coil high beside his head and calls out with the mouth open while the pole stays angled forward, holds it briefly, then lowers the coil back to the hip in the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse continuously from standing: he doubles over, sinks onto his knees with the pole dragging, falls forward onto his hands and slumps flat, finishing lying motionless face down with the hood at screen right and the boots at screen left, the rope coil and the hooked pole lying on the ground beside him. No recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
